description: Plan for Windows SmartScreen: unsigned or new-cert apps get "Unknown publisher" warnings that scare users. Options: EV code signing (instant trust), OV cert + reputation building (submit to Microsoft for review, accumulate downloads), or winget/Chocolatey/Scoop package manager submission for trusted distribution. Document the chosen strategy and user-facing guidance for "Windows protected your PC" prompts during early adoption.
title: SmartScreen reputation and distribution strategy
